title: City Gates
summary: City gates were places of entry, public business, legal decisions, witness, and community authority.
background: Many biblical scenes at the gate involve judgment, elders, contracts, royal action, or public honor and shame.
teachingHelp: When a passage happens at the gate, watch for public witness, official decision, community accountability, or legal significance.
sources: James M. Freeman, Hand-book of Bible Manners and Customs (1874 / early public-domain editions).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
